description: Power distribution and transmission transformers (pole-mount, pad-mount, substation)
complianceNotes: Dissolved-gas analysis annually; oil sampling per IEC 60599; PCB compliance

description: Overhead and underground power-line segments including poles and cables
complianceNotes: Vegetation-management clearance; thermal imaging inspection cycle

description: Advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) devices for electricity, gas, or water
complianceNotes: Requires annual calibration per IEC 62052; firmware-update tracking; data-privacy compliance

description: Electrical substations for voltage step-up/step-down and distribution switching
complianceNotes: NERC CIP compliance (or local grid-code equivalent); arc-flash study every 5 years

description: Water, gas, or oil pipeline segments including valves and fittings
complianceNotes: Inline inspection (pigging) per PHMSA or local pipeline-safety authority; cathodic-protection monitoring

description: Water/wastewater lift stations and booster-pump facilities
complianceNotes: EPA NPDES permit compliance; SCADA alarm-response SLA

description: Potable-water and fire-service mains including hydrants
complianceNotes: Flushing programme; hydrant flow-test per NFPA 25 or local standard

description: Telecommunications towers, monopoles, and antenna mounts
complianceNotes: Structural inspection per TIA-222 or local code; FAA lighting compliance where applicable

description: Signalised intersections including controllers, signal heads, and detection equipment
Road, rail, or pedestrian bridges and culverts
complianceNotes: NBIS biennial inspection; load-rating review; scour-critical assessment

description: Photovoltaic panels, inverters, and racking systems
complianceNotes: Performance-ratio monitoring; panel-cleaning schedule; inverter firmware updates

description: Onshore or offshore wind-turbine generators including nacelle, tower, and blades
complianceNotes: Blade inspection via drone/rope-access; gearbox oil analysis; lightning-protection system check
